description: This PHP class, OAuthCodeMarkDeletedService, handles the process of marking OAuth2 authorization codes as deleted after a certain threshold. It interacts with the database to update records and logs its activities.

classes.name: OAuthCodeMarkDeletedService
classes.description: A service class responsible for marking expired OAuth2 authorization codes as deleted based on a configured threshold.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the process to update OAuth2 authorization codes that have expired beyond a threshold, setting their 'deleted' flag to true.

methods.name: getDBManager
methods.description: Retrieves the database manager instance; throws an exception if the connection cannot be established.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with specified severity and section details.

methods.name: getOAuthCodeDeleteThreshold
methods.description: Returns the threshold time for deleting OAuth codes, defaulting to '-7 days' if configuration is invalid or missing.
